title: now_rfc2822() duplicated identically in 4 test files
description: A ~30-line now_rfc2822() function appears copy-pasted in nntp_conformance.rs, two_process_harness.rs, e2e_data_flow.rs, and fault_store_errors.rs. Duplicated test helpers are a maintenance trap: if the RFC 2822 formatting ever needs a bug fix (e.g., DST offset), the fix must be applied in 4 places and someone will miss one. Suggested rewrite: extract to a crate-level test helper module (e.g., a tests/helpers/ module or a test-only sub-crate) and import from there.
